surprises.head: Anaheim found the good looks for once
surprises.body: Anaheim usually gets worse looks than most teams. Not tonight: a 9.0% chance of scoring on the average shot at 5-on-5, against their usual 6.0% and a league average of 6.3%. A team strays this far about once every 40 games.

story.head: The Ducks run away from the Jets
paras: The Jets’ Kyle Connor played his 700th NHL game. Judd Caulfield, in his fourth NHL game, scored his first NHL goal, set up by Jeff Malott, late in the first to open the scoring for the Ducks. Travis Mitchell and Adam Lowry squared off later in the period. Tim Washe stretched the lead to 2-0 early in the second. The third period was a wild one. Sam Colangelo made it 3-0 early in the period, but Connor got the Jets on the board midway through the period. Mikael Granlund scored his 200th NHL goal three and a half minutes later to make it 4-1 for the Ducks. Nikita Nesterenko added an empty-net goal with 41 seconds left to make it 5-1.
Don’t let the score fool you: the chances were a lot closer than that. Lukáš Dostál made 16 saves for the Ducks, and Clay Stevenson stopped 12 of 16.
The Ducks killed all four Jets power plays. The Ducks improved to 3-1-0, and the Jets fell to 3-1-1.

items.text: Kyle Connor passed Ilya Kovalchuk for third on the Jets’ all-time goals list, with 329.
The Jets’ three-game winning streak is over.
The Ducks have beaten the Jets four straight times, going back to last season.
One of the preview’s three calls held.
